params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T11:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T11:20:00Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted   = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed     = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                              message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other"),
           source.ip, user.name
| SORT accepted DESC, failed DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T11:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T11:20:00Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| KEEP @timestamp, event.outcome, source.ip, user.name, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 100

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T11:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T11:20:00Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
        AND message LIKE "*Accepted*"
| KEEP @timestamp, source.ip, user.name, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 100

which hosts dev.dana normally logs into
whether dev.dana has ever appeared in failed auth events before 2026-07-26
whether 172.18.0.11 is among dev.dana's normal source IPs
typical auth frequency and timing pattern for dev.dana

params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-26T11:08:28Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T11:08:28Z"
        AND user.name == "dev.dana"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted   = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed     = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                              message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other"),
           source.ip, host.name
| SORT accepted DESC, failed DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp < "2026-07-26T00:00:00Z"
        AND user.name == "dev.dana"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed_count = COUNT(*),
        first_failed = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_failed = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip, host.name
| SORT failed_count DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE user.name == "dev.dana"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.11"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
| STATS accepted_count = COUNT(*)
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-system.auth-*
